entities.merge_help_body: Merges two entities the indexer treated as distinct but that represent the same thing. All occurrences of the source entity are reassigned to the target, then the source is deleted and the occurrence count is recalculated. After the merge you can link the single resulting entity to an authority URI (VIAF, Wikidata, etc.).
entities.merge_help_example: Example: "Giovanni Boccaccio" and "G. Boccaccio" were indexed separately — merge them so all documents appear under one entry.

entities.reindex_all_description: Runs a full re-index on every collection in sequence. This may take several minutes for large corpora.
entities.reindex_all_confirm: Re-index all collections? This will wipe and rebuild the entity index for every collection. The operation may take several minutes.
entities.config_description: Define which TEI elements are extracted during indexing. The tag name (e.g. persName) is stored directly as the entity type. Changes take effect on the next re-index.
entities.config_stale_warning: Configuration changed — re-index all collections to apply the new tag list.
entities.config_help_title: Main TEI tags for named entities
entities.config_help_body:
**People & Organisations**
`persName` — Names of real or fictional persons.
`orgName` — Names of institutions, groups or societies.
`name` — Generic proper name (use with {'@'}type="person", "place", etc.).

**Objects & Materials**
`objectName` — Proper names of objects (e.g. "Achilles' spear").
`object` — Description or mention of a physical object.
`material` — Substances or materials (gold, silk, wood).

**Measures & Quantities**
`measure` — Any kind of measure (weight, length, currency). Use {'@'}unit and {'@'}quantity.
`num` — Numbers written as digits or words (use {'@'}value for normalisation).
`dim` — Generic non-standard dimensions.
`height` / `width` / `depth` — Specific dimensions (often inside `dimensions`).

**Currency**
`measure` with {'@'}type="currency" — Standard way to mark sums of money.
`unit` — Can be used inside `measure` to specify the currency.

**Places**
`placeName` — Names of cities, states, rivers or geographic locations.
`geogName` — Names of geographic features (e.g. "Mont Blanc").

gitlab.initialize_available_hint: This collection is empty and can be initialized from the linked GitLab project. Initialize copies every XML file in the repo into Aracne2 as a one-time operation — after that, push is the only allowed direction.
gitlab.initialize_confirm: Confirm: import every XML file from the project into this empty collection. This cannot be undone.
gitlab.initialize_success: Imported {n} XML files from GitLab at {sha}.
gitlab.website_section_hint: Push the rendered static output of this website to a GitLab project as a single commit. Build the site first (STATIC or HYBRID mode) — a DYNAMIC site has nothing to deposit.
gitlab.website_plugin_not_active: The GitLab Integration plugin is not active on this installation. Activate it at /admin/plugins to enable deposit.
gitlab.website_cannot_push_dynamic: This website uses DYNAMIC rendering — there is no static output to push.
gitlab.website_cannot_push_not_built: Build the website first, then push.

crossref.button_hint: Paste a DOI and insert the corresponding TEI <biblStruct> fragment via CrossRef
crossref.panel_subtitle: Proxies the public CrossRef /works/{doi} API. No credentials needed — CrossRef identifies the operator through a contact email in the User-Agent (polite pool).
crossref.contact_email_hint: Sent as mailto: inside the User-Agent on every CrossRef request. Leave empty to fall back to the platform admin_email.
crossref.fallback_notice: Empty — requests will use the platform admin email ({email}).
crossref.restart_required: Plugin admin endpoints are not yet available. If you have just activated the plugin, reload this page; otherwise check that the plugin is healthy on the server.
crossref.doi_hint: Accepts bare DOIs or the full doi.org URL. The platform contacts CrossRef on your behalf.
crossref.idle_hint: Paste a DOI and click Resolve to preview the biblStruct that will be inserted.
crossref.footer_hint: Insert drops the fragment at the cursor position and re-indents it to match the surrounding document.
crossref.error_not_found: CrossRef does not know this DOI. Check the spelling or try the publisher's website.
crossref.error_upstream: CrossRef could not be reached. Try again in a moment.

help.panel_subtitle: In-app documentation browser. Serves the Markdown files under backend/help_docs/ as sanitised HTML with full-text search — no external service, no credentials.
help.no_config_notice: This plugin has no configuration. Activate it and a Help link appears in the left sidebar; a Help badge appears in the Dashboard quick-access row.
help.usage_hint: After activation, remember to restart the backend once so the plugin's routes are mounted. Further edits to the Markdown sources are picked up on the next request thanks to the mtime-based cache.
help.title: Help
help.subtitle: Browse the in-app documentation
help.empty_tree: No help content available. Add .md files to backend/help_docs/ and refresh.
help.refresh_done: Help cache cleared — next request will re-parse.

gnd.panel_subtitle: Searches the GND (Gemeinsame Normdatei) via lobid.org so editors can resolve a <persName> / <placeName> / <orgName> selection to a canonical GND URI.
gnd.no_config_notice: This plugin has no configuration. It proxies lobid.org, the public open wrapper for the GND — no credentials required.
gnd.usage_hint: The TEI editor adds a GND chip to the authority cluster when this plugin is active. GND is especially useful for German-language scholarship.
gnd.button_hint: Find a GND identifier for the selected entity and write it as {'@'}ref
gnd.idle_hint: Type at least two characters to search.
gnd.apply_error_no_enclosing_tag: Place the cursor inside a TEI element before linking.
gnd.apply_error_not_entity_tag: GND applies to <persName> / <placeName> / <orgName>; the enclosing element is <{tag}>.

cerl.panel_subtitle: Searches the CERL Thesaurus — the go-to authority for early printed books (pre-1830): persons, places, imprints, corporate bodies.
cerl.no_config_notice: This plugin has no configuration. CERL exposes a public JSON endpoint — no credentials required.
cerl.usage_hint: The TEI editor adds a CERL chip when this plugin is active. CERL's 'imprint' hits (printers, booksellers) apply to <orgName>.
cerl.button_hint: Find a CERL identifier for the selected entity and write it as {'@'}ref
cerl.idle_hint: Type at least two characters to search.
cerl.footer_hint: Writes {'@'}ref="https://data.cerl.org/thesaurus/…" on the enclosing entity tag.
cerl.apply_error_no_enclosing_tag: Place the cursor inside a TEI element before linking.
cerl.apply_error_not_entity_tag: CERL applies to <persName> / <placeName> / <orgName>; the enclosing element is <{tag}>.

peripleo.panel_subtitle: Searches Peripleo (Pelagios Network), which aggregates Pleiades + iDAI.gazetteer + ChronOntology + other ancient-world gazetteers. Returns the canonical URI of the source gazetteer.
peripleo.no_config_notice: This plugin has no configuration. Peripleo is a public research infrastructure — no credentials required.
peripleo.usage_hint: The TEI editor adds a Peripleo chip when this plugin is active. Apply on <placeName>.
peripleo.button_hint: Find an ancient-place URI for the selected name and write it as {'@'}ref
peripleo.idle_hint: Type at least two characters to search.
peripleo.footer_hint: Writes {'@'}ref to the enclosing <placeName>, using the source gazetteer URI (Pleiades, iDAI, …).
peripleo.apply_error_no_enclosing_tag: Place the cursor inside a TEI element before linking.
peripleo.apply_error_not_entity_tag: Peripleo applies to <placeName>; the enclosing element is <{tag}>.

getty_aat.panel_subtitle: Queries the Getty Art & Architecture Thesaurus (materials, techniques, object types, styles, periods) via the public SPARQL endpoint.
getty_aat.no_config_notice: This plugin has no configuration. The Getty SPARQL endpoint is public — no credentials required.
getty_aat.usage_hint: The TEI editor adds a Getty AAT chip when this plugin is active. Apply on a TEI <term> element.
getty_aat.button_hint: Find a Getty AAT concept for the selected term and write it as {'@'}ref on a <term>
getty_aat.search_placeholder: Search AAT (oil paint, lapis lazuli, codex…)
getty_aat.idle_hint: Type at least two characters to search.
getty_aat.apply_error_no_enclosing_tag: Place the cursor inside a TEI element before linking.
getty_aat.apply_error_not_entity_tag: Getty AAT applies to <term>; the enclosing element is <{tag}>.

openalex.panel_subtitle: Searches OpenAlex, the open bibliographic index of ~250M scholarly works. Inserts a ready-to-use TEI <biblStruct> fragment at the cursor — complementary to the CrossRef DOI resolver for works without a DOI.
openalex.button_hint: Search OpenAlex and insert the corresponding TEI <biblStruct> fragment
openalex.idle_hint: Type at least two characters to search.
openalex.footer_hint: Drops a <biblStruct> at the cursor. Complements the CrossRef DOI button for works without a DOI.
openalex.field_contact_email_hint: Sent to OpenAlex as ?mailto=… so they can reach the operator if rate limits need tuning. Fallback: {fallback}.

trismegistos.panel_subtitle: Resolves a Trismegistos ID (person, place, or text) to its canonical URL and shows partner-database cross-references (DDBDP, HGV, PHI, EDH, EDCS, ...). Supports reverse lookup from a partner ID. Uses only public Trismegistos endpoints — no API key required.
trismegistos.button_hint: Resolve a Trismegistos ID and write its URL as {'@'}ref
trismegistos.resolver_intro: Paste a Trismegistos ID (or a partner-project ID + source for texts) to resolve it.
trismegistos.idle_hint: Fill in the ID above and click Resolve.
trismegistos.not_found: Trismegistos has no record matching that ID.
trismegistos.text_not_applicable: Text record — copy the URL manually.
trismegistos.footer_hint: Writes {'@'}ref to the enclosing <persName> / <placeName>. Text records are shown for reference only.
trismegistos.apply_error_no_enclosing_tag: Place the cursor inside a TEI element before linking.
trismegistos.apply_error_not_entity_tag: Trismegistos applies to <persName> / <placeName>; the enclosing element is <{tag}>.
trismegistos.no_config_notice: The Trismegistos plugin has no tunable settings — the public ID-resolver endpoints it uses require no credentials.
trismegistos.usage_hint: Open a document in the editor, click the TMG chip, pick the kind, and paste a Trismegistos (or partner-project) ID.

viaf.panel_subtitle: Searches the VIAF AutoSuggest API so editors can resolve a <persName> or <orgName> selection to a canonical VIAF URI.
viaf.no_config_notice: This plugin has no configuration. It proxies the public VIAF AutoSuggest API — no credentials required. Activate it and use the VIAF button in the TEI editor toolbar.
viaf.usage_hint: The TEI editor gains a VIAF button alongside ORCID and ROR. Select a person or institution name, click VIAF, pick a hit, and {'@'}ref is written on the enclosing <persName> or <orgName>.
viaf.button_hint: Find a VIAF identifier for the selected person or institution and write it as {'@'}ref
viaf.idle_hint: Type at least two characters to search.
viaf.footer_hint: Writes {'@'}ref="http://viaf.org/viaf/…" on the <persName> or <orgName> enclosing the cursor.
viaf.apply_error_no_enclosing_tag: Place the cursor inside a TEI element before linking.
viaf.apply_error_not_entity_tag: VIAF can only be applied to <persName> or <orgName>; the enclosing element is <{tag}>.

geonames.panel_subtitle: Searches GeoNames populated places so editors can resolve a <placeName> selection to a canonical GeoNames URI.
geonames.button_hint: Find a GeoNames identifier for the selected place and write it as {'@'}ref on the enclosing <placeName>
geonames.idle_hint: Type at least two characters to search.
geonames.footer_hint: Writes {'@'}ref="…" on the <placeName> enclosing the cursor. URI format is configurable in the plugin settings.
geonames.apply_error_no_enclosing_tag: Place the cursor inside a TEI element before linking.
geonames.apply_error_not_entity_tag: GeoNames can only be applied to <placeName>; the enclosing element is <{tag}>.
geonames.field_url_format_web_hint: Human-readable page URL. Clicking the link in a rendered document lands on geonames.org.
geonames.field_url_format_sws_hint: Semantic-web URI used by Linked Open Data vocabularies. Not directly clickable in a browser.
geonames.field_username_hint: Shared with the core collection-create form. Change it in Admin → Settings (key: geonames_username).

ror.panel_subtitle: Searches the public Research Organization Registry (ROR) so editors can resolve an <orgName> selection to a canonical ROR URI.
ror.no_config_notice: This plugin has no configuration. It proxies the public ROR search API on your behalf — no credentials required. Activate it and use the ROR button in the TEI editor toolbar.
ror.usage_hint: The TEI editor gains a ROR button next to the ORCID button. Select an institution name, click ROR, pick a hit, and {'@'}ref is written on the enclosing <orgName>.
ror.button_hint: Find a ROR identifier for the selected institution and write it as {'@'}ref on the enclosing <orgName>
ror.idle_hint: Type at least two characters to search.
ror.footer_hint: Writes {'@'}ref="https://ror.org/…" on the <orgName> enclosing the cursor.
ror.apply_error_no_enclosing_tag: Place the cursor inside a TEI element before linking.
ror.apply_error_not_entity_tag: ROR can only be applied to <orgName>; the enclosing element is <{tag}>.

orcid.panel_subtitle: Searches the public ORCID registry so editors can resolve a <persName> selection to a canonical ORCID URI.
orcid.no_config_notice: This plugin has no configuration. It proxies the public ORCID search API on your behalf — no credentials required. Activate it and use the ORCID button in the TEI editor toolbar.
orcid.usage_hint: The TEI editor gains an ORCID button next to the Wikidata button. Select a name, click ORCID, pick a hit, and {'@'}ref is written on the enclosing <persName>.
orcid.button_hint: Find an ORCID iD for the selected person and write it as {'@'}ref on the enclosing <persName>
orcid.idle_hint: Type at least two characters to search.
orcid.footer_hint: Writes {'@'}ref="https://orcid.org/…" on the <persName> enclosing the cursor.
orcid.apply_error_no_enclosing_tag: Place the cursor inside a TEI element before linking.
orcid.apply_error_not_entity_tag: ORCID can only be applied to <persName>; the enclosing element is <{tag}>.

wikidata.button_hint: Resolve the current selection to a Wikidata URI and write it as {'@'}ref
wikidata.panel_subtitle: Searches the public Wikidata wbsearchentities API so editors can resolve a <persName> / <placeName> / <orgName> selection to a canonical Wikidata URI.
wikidata.no_config_notice: This plugin has no configuration. It proxies the public Wikidata search API — no credentials required. Activate it and use the Wikidata button in the TEI editor toolbar.
wikidata.usage_hint: The TEI editor shows a Wikidata button in the top-right authority cluster. Select a name, click Wikidata, pick a hit, and {'@'}ref is written on the enclosing entity tag.
wikidata.idle_hint: Type at least two characters to search.
wikidata.footer_hint: Applies {'@'}ref="…" to the persName / placeName / orgName tag enclosing the cursor.
wikidata.apply_error_no_enclosing_tag: Place the cursor inside a TEI element before linking.
wikidata.apply_error_not_entity_tag: The enclosing element <{tag}> is not a linkable entity (persName, placeName, orgName).

website_media.tab_intro: Upload images once here — logo, cover, illustrations — then pick them from this library anywhere the site needs an image. Click a file to copy its 'media://' reference; the renderer turns it into a real URL at serve/build time.
website_media.upload_hint: JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, GIF or SVG · up to 8 MB
website_media.empty: No images uploaded yet. Click 'Upload image' to add the first one.
website_media.confirm_delete: Delete '{filename}'? Pages that reference it will render a broken image until the reference is removed.

zotero_import.panel_subtitle: Imports bibliographic entries from a configured Zotero group or user library into a collection's bibliography. Entries are mapped to TEI <biblStruct> and de-duplicated by Zotero item key.
zotero_import.api_key_hint: Read-only key scoped to the library you want to import from.
zotero_import.library_type_hint: Zotero libraries are either a personal user library or a shared group library.
zotero_import.library_id_hint: Numeric identifier of the Zotero library (found in the library's settings page URL).
zotero_import.api_base_hint: Leave empty to use https://api.zotero.org. Useful for pointing at a test environment or a mirror.
zotero_import.restart_required: Plugin admin endpoints are not yet available. If you have just activated the plugin, reload this page; otherwise check that the plugin is healthy on the server.
zotero_import.collection_section_hint: Pull entries from the configured Zotero library into a new bibliography version.
zotero_import.no_new: No new items to import — every entry in the library has already been imported for this collection.
zotero_import.success_toast: Imported {n} new item(s) as bibliography version {version}.

internet_archive.panel_subtitle: Submits published collections to the Wayback Machine via Save Page Now 2. Generate an access/secret key pair on archive.org and paste them below.
internet_archive.secret_key_hint: S3-style secret key paired with the access key.
internet_archive.auto_archive_hint: When on, publishing a collection automatically submits its public URL to Save Page Now. Turn off to archive only via the manual button on each collection.
internet_archive.restart_required: Plugin admin endpoints are not yet available. If you have just activated the plugin, reload this page; otherwise check that the plugin is healthy on the server.
internet_archive.badge_pending_hint: Save Page Now is still processing the capture. Use the Refresh button to re-poll.
internet_archive.badge_failed_hint: The capture attempt failed — see the plugin settings and retry.
internet_archive.collection_section_hint: Submit this collection's public URL to the Internet Archive Wayback Machine. Available once the collection is published.
internet_archive.collection_needs_published: Wayback archiving is available only after the collection is published.
internet_archive.website_section_hint: Submit this website's public URL ({slug_path}) to the Internet Archive's Wayback Machine. All rendering modes are supported — Wayback only needs a URL that returns HTML. Manual: clicking Archive triggers a fresh capture.
internet_archive.website_plugin_not_active: The Internet Archive plugin is not active on this installation. Activate it at /admin/plugins to archive websites on Wayback.

dataverse.panel_subtitle: Deposits collections and websites on a Dataverse instance — the public sandbox at demo.dataverse.org by default, or any institutional Dataverse via the configurable base URL. Per-deposit alias override is supported when one institution hosts multiple research-group Dataverses.
dataverse.field_token_set: A token is currently configured (value hidden). Paste a new token below to replace it, or click Clear to remove it.
dataverse.field_token_unset: No token yet. The plugin cannot deposit until an API token is set.
dataverse.field_token_hint: Generate a token from your Dataverse account page (My Data → API Token).
dataverse.field_base_url_hint: Leave at https://demo.dataverse.org for the public sandbox; change to https://dataverse.<institution>.it (or wherever) for production.
dataverse.field_default_alias_hint: The sub-Dataverse that hosts the datasets created by this plugin (e.g. "tei-editions"). Each deposit can override this on a per-collection / per-website basis.
dataverse.field_contact_email_hint: Required by Dataverse on every dataset. Falls back to the platform's admin_email when empty.
dataverse.field_auto_deposit_hint: When on, publishing a collection automatically creates a Dataverse dataset. Off by default — turn on once you've validated the setup against the sandbox.
dataverse.field_auto_publish_hint: When on, the deposit immediately releases the dataset (DOI activates and resolves via doi.org). When off, the dataset stays as a DRAFT for manual review on Dataverse.
dataverse.collection_section_hint: Push this collection's TEI files to the configured Dataverse as a new dataset. Per-deposit alias override is available below.
dataverse.website_section_hint: Push the rendered static output of this website to a Dataverse dataset. STATIC and HYBRID modes are supported (DYNAMIC has no static output to deposit). Build the site first.
dataverse.website_plugin_not_active: The Dataverse Integration plugin is not active on this installation. Activate it at /admin/plugins to deposit on Dataverse.
dataverse.website_cannot_deposit_dynamic: This website uses DYNAMIC rendering — there is no static output to deposit.
dataverse.website_cannot_deposit_not_built: Build the website first, then deposit.
dataverse.upload_as_zip_label: Bundle as a single ZIP archive
dataverse.upload_as_zip_hint: On (default): the rendered tree is wrapped into one {slug}.zip and uploaded as a single artefact. Off: every file is uploaded individually under its directoryLabel so the Dataverse Files tab stays browsable.
dataverse.override_alias_link: Use a different alias for this deposit…
dataverse.draft_doi_caveat: Note: the DOI shown on a draft is preallocated by Dataverse but does not resolve via doi.org until the dataset is published. Use the "Open Dataverse dataset" link to inspect the draft.

zenodo.panel_subtitle: Configure credentials and defaults used when the plugin deposits a published collection on Zenodo.
zenodo.inactive_notice: Plugin inactive — activate it above to start depositing on publish.
zenodo.api_token_hint: Personal access token with the deposit:actions and deposit:write scopes.
zenodo.endpoint_hint: Use sandbox for test deposits; production deposits are permanent and cannot be deleted.
zenodo.community_hint: Optional Zenodo community slug to submit deposits to (leave empty to skip).
zenodo.access_hint: Open records are publicly visible; restricted records only to authorised Zenodo users.
zenodo.resource_type_hint: Populated live from Zenodo's resource-type vocabulary. Pick the closest match for this deposit.
zenodo.public_base_url_hint: Canonical origin (no trailing slash) used by the plugin to link each deposit back to the collection page on this site.
zenodo.auto_publish_hint: When on, deposits are published immediately (DOI minted). When off, they stay as drafts for manual review on Zenodo.
zenodo.restart_required: Plugin admin endpoints are not yet available. If you have just activated the plugin, reload this page; otherwise check that the plugin is healthy on the server.
zenodo.badge_draft_hint: Open the Zenodo draft for review
zenodo.badge_failed_hint: The last deposit attempt failed — check the plugin settings and retry.
zenodo.collection_section_hint: Per-collection options for how this collection is deposited on Zenodo. Leave the resource type at the default to inherit the global setting.
zenodo.collection_upload_as_zip_hint: Bundle every TEI document in the collection into one {slug}.zip file instead of uploading each XML as a separate file on the Zenodo record.
zenodo.website_section_hint: Deposit the rendered static output of this website on Zenodo. STATIC and HYBRID modes are supported (DYNAMIC has no static output to deposit). Build the site first.
zenodo.website_plugin_not_active: The Zenodo Deposit plugin is not active on this installation. Activate it at /admin/plugins to deposit websites on Zenodo.
zenodo.website_cannot_deposit_dynamic: This website uses DYNAMIC rendering — there is no static output to deposit.
zenodo.website_cannot_deposit_not_built: Build the website first, then deposit.
zenodo.upload_as_zip_label: Bundle as a single ZIP archive
zenodo.upload_as_zip_hint: On (default): the rendered tree is wrapped into one {slug}.zip and uploaded as a single artefact — best for archival. Off: every file is uploaded individually and stays browsable in the Zenodo record's Files tab.
